answer: Random groves of eight sink together. A key docks 2,000 POA in the group's harbor, a joint escrow frozen until close. Each member has three minutes to forge a unique 48-byte proof bound to its key; five foreign auditors have 80 seconds to flag a copy or shared payer. One bad proof burns 600 POA from every harbor share and exiles the grove 15 epochs. Honest outlay: 2,000 POA and one proof. 1,000 fakes lock 2 million POA, and one clustered copy can wipe 4.8 million, vs ~160 POA farmed. Cartels may pack a grove; redraw groups each epoch and reject any with fewer than five unrelated funding paths.
